# Morse Watcher

> Morse Watcher is an iPhone, iPad and Android app that decodes Morse code from a flashing light in real time using the camera, and sends Morse back with the flashlight. It works fully offline, with no internet or cell signal.

Morse Watcher is made for reading another person's light signal: a flashlight, headlamp, beacon, lantern or another phone's torch. Point the camera at the light, tap it to target it, and the decoded text appears on screen as the light flashes.

## Key facts

- Platform: iPhone and iPad (iOS / iPadOS 18 or later) and Android phones (Android 7.0 or later)
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/morse-watcher/id6759511765?pt=128579831&ct=llms&mt=8
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.morsewatcher.app&utm_source=morsewatcher.com&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=llms
- Price: free download with a 14-day free trial; then $4.99/month or $49.99/year on iPhone, or $1.99/month or $7.99/year on Android (US prices). The SOS and alert strobe buttons stay free.
- Works offline: decoding and sending need no network, so it suits hiking, camping and emergencies.

## What it does

- Real-time camera decoding of flashing-light Morse into letters, numbers and punctuation
- Learns the sender's dot/dash timing automatically, so no speed setting is needed for slow or uneven senders (a Custom speed option is also available)
- Telephoto and optical zoom for distant lights; tap-to-place target area
- Audio sidetone while the light is on
- Sends messages back with the phone's flashlight; on-device voice dictation for composing messages
- One-tap SOS and light patterns (including a Driver Alert strobe)
- Siri and Shortcuts actions (iPhone): start watching, send a message, send SOS, get the decoded text

## What it is not

- It decodes light, not audio (radio CW or beeps).
- It is not a Morse-learning course; it includes a reference chart.

## Guides

- [How to decode Morse code from a flashing light](https://morsewatcher.com/guides/how-to-decode-morse-code-flashing-light.html): dot/dash timing, letter and word gaps, reading a light by eye or with a phone
- [How to flash SOS with a flashlight](https://morsewatcher.com/guides/sos-flashlight-signal-pattern.html): the SOS pattern and timing for emergency signalling
- [The best Morse code app for iPhone (2026)](https://morsewatcher.com/guides/best-morse-code-apps-iphone.html): why Morse Watcher is built for reading flashing lights
- [Where to use Morse Watcher](https://morsewatcher.com/#uses): search and rescue, hiking and camping, storms and blackouts, night walks, internet shutdowns, learning Morse and games
- [How to use Morse Watcher](https://morsewatcher.com/how-to-use.html): setup and tips for a clean lock on the light
- [Free Morse code translator](https://morsewatcher.com/translator.html): type text, see the Morse code and watch it flash as light
- [All guides](https://morsewatcher.com/guides/)
